title: Permission, Notice, and the Word
label: ch:permiso-y-voz
canDo: I can say el permiso, el aviso, la disculpa, la palabra and la voz, and say which Greek geometry term became the Spanish word for word.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C332-voz: open the noun inside con permiso, give an aviso, offer a disculpa, and carry a palabra on your voz.
